title: router
description: v0.1 device-model entity: the van's uplink router (Teltonika RUT-360), bridged from the router's RutOS Data to Server MQTT feed. Published under renewvan/router/<id>/<property>.

signal_rsrp_dbm.description: Reference Signal Received Power in dBm; the primary cellular signal metric.

signal_rsrq_db.description: Reference Signal Received Quality in dB.

signal_rssi_dbm.description: Received Signal Strength Indicator in dBm.

operator.description: PLMN as reported by the modem: numeric MCC+MNC (e.g. "26203"), not a display name — mapping codes to operator names is presentation, not node business.

network_type.description: Mobile network technology. Normalized to lowercase from the modem's conntype ("LTE" → "lte", 5G forms → "nr"). `unknown` is the forward-compat fallback for any value not in this enum.

data_used_month_tx_b.description: SIM data transmitted this calendar month, in bytes (device-scoped month window).

data_used_month_rx_b.description: SIM data received this calendar month, in bytes (device-scoped month window).
